title: Appeals
intro: Your removed questions, bans and demerits. You can appeal each one once, and a moderator other than you decides.
signIn: <link>Sign in</link> to see your removed questions, bans and demerits.
nothing: Nothing to appeal. Removed questions, bans and demerits would show here.
sent: Your appeal is in. You'll see the outcome here.
autoWhy: Removed automatically because many of the people who answered it reported it.
autoFix: If it asks a fair true-or-false question, appeal and a moderator will look at it.
harm: Marked as {kind, select, hateful {hateful} harassing {harassing} private_person {targeting a private person} spam {spam} other {harmful}}.
banAsking: No asking until {date}. You can still vote and browse.
demerit: {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}, expires {date}.
demeritKind: For: {kind, select, hateful {a hateful question} harassing {a harassing question} private_person {targeting a private person} spam {spam} other {a harmful question}}

status.open: Appeal sent. Waiting for a moderator.
status.overturned: Appeal decided: the decision was reversed.

errors.empty: Say why it should be reversed.
errors.not_yours: That isn't something you can appeal.

askBan.title: You can't ask questions right now
askBan.until: After repeated harmful questions, this account can't ask questions until {date}. You can still vote and browse.
askBan.permanent: This account is banned for vote manipulation.
